_설명: 천일문 3권 Chapter 06 분사 Chapter Test 뒷부분(15~18번)에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 심화 10과 분사구문 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.prompt: 다음 내용을 보고 주어진 단어를 사용하여 <보기>와 같이 문장을 완성하세요.
body: <보기> Eating popcorn, Nari is watching a movie. (popcorn, eat)
(1) ________________ for hours, my dad got tired. (the car, wash)
(2) ________________, I can’t buy the ticket. (enough money, have)
questions.answer: (1) Washing the car  (2) Not having enough money

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: 나는 너무 심하게 다쳐서 더 이상 뛸 수 없었다. → Injured so badly, I couldn’t run anymore.
얇은 옷을 입어서, 그 소녀는 조금 추웠다. → Wearing thin clothing, the girl felt a little cold.
우리 이모가 지난 주말에 내 시계를 고쳐 주셨다. → My aunt had my watch repairing last weekend.
내 친구들은 그 공연을 좋아했지만, 그것은 나에게 지루했다. → My friends liked the show, but it was bored to me.
내 여동생은 빵 조각을 함께 나르고 있는 개미들을 보고 있었다. → My little sister was watching ants carrying a piece of bread together.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: Saying goodbye, Mina got on the bus. = Mina said goodbye and got on the bus.
Watching the touching drama, Lily cried a lot. = When Lily watched the touching drama, she cried a lot.
Feeling very tired, he skipped dinner. = Though he was very tired, he skipped dinner.
Not bringing my raincoat, I couldn’t avoid getting wet. = I couldn’t avoid getting wet as I didn’t bring my raincoat.
Because Joanna had heavy bags, she took a taxi to the airport. = Being had heavy bags, Joanna took a taxi to the airport.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: ⓐ Not have breakfast, Sally was hungry.
ⓑ My brother studies with the window closing.
ⓒ Bitten by a bee, my hand was so swollen.
ⓓ The writer’s new poem is very interesting.
ⓔ The children playing the card games are my cousins.
ⓕ Opened the door, I found my cat coming out to greet me.
ⓖ Mina heard her name called from behind, so she looked back.
